files.Title: OnixRuntime.Api.Events.OnixEventRendering.OnHudRender2DDelegate
files.Summary: This event is called when on hud, hide hud is false and there is no client UI screen opened. This will be called from the user's preferred 2D renderer. This may or may not be a logic callback so don't access game state, entities, etc.

files.Title: OnixRuntime.Api.Events.OnixEventRendering.OnHudRenderDelegate
files.Summary: Called when HUD should be rendered via the game's renderer. Logic-safe: game state and entities are available.

files.Title: OnixRuntime.Api.Events.OnixEventRendering.OnPreRenderScreenDelegate
files.Summary: Delegate for the game's rendering callbacks (always logic-safe).

files.Title: OnixRuntime.Api.Events.OnixEventRendering.OnPreRenderScreenDirect2DDelegate
files.Summary: This event is called all the time. The Pre is before the client's screens are rendered, not the game's. You should avoid this if gives you what you need. debug_screen should always be there if you want to pick that one, otherwise you can ignore debug_screen and toast_screen to have just the main screen. This will never be a logic callback so don't access game state, entities, etc.

files.Title: OnixRuntime.Api.Events.OnixEventRendering.OnRenderHudDirect2DDelegate
files.Summary: This event is called when on hud, hide hud is false and there is no client UI screen opened. This will be called from the user's preferred 2D renderer. This will never be a logic callback so don't access game state, entities, etc.

files.Title: OnixRuntime.Api.Events.OnixEventRendering.OnRenderScreen2DDelegate
files.Summary: This event is called all the time. You should avoid this if gives you what you need. This will be called from the user's preferred 2D renderer. This may or may not be a logic callback so don't access game state, entities, etc. There is no PreRenderScreen2D event, because depending on the renderer, pre means different things. You can handle this case manually by checking the different pre events and .

files.Title: OnixRuntime.Api.Events.OnixEventRendering.OnRenderScreenDelegate
files.Summary: This event is called all the time. (always logic-safe) This is a logic callback so you can access game state, entities, etc.

files.Title: OnixRuntime.Api.Events.OnixEventRendering.OnRenderScreenDirect2DDelegate
files.Summary: This event is called all the time. You should avoid this if gives you what you need. This will never be a logic callback so don't access game state, entities, etc.

files.Title: OnixRuntime.Api.World.Scoreboards.Scoreboard
files.Summary: Represents a scoreboard, providing access to objectives, display objectives, and score manipulation methods.

files.Title: OnixRuntime.Api.World.Scoreboards.ScoreboardDisplayObjective
files.Summary: Represents a display objective in the scoreboard, providing access to sort order and ordered scores.

files.Title: OnixRuntime.Api.World.Scoreboards.ScoreboardDisplayObjectivePosition
files.Summary: Specifies the display position for a scoreboard objective.

files.Title: OnixRuntime.Api.World.Scoreboards.ScoreboardIdentity.IdentityType
files.Summary: Represents the type of identity this is, such as Player, Entity, or FakePlayer (just a name).

files.Title: OnixRuntime.Api.World.Scoreboards.ScoreboardIdentity
files.Summary: Represents a scoreboard identity, which can be a player, entity, or fake player (just a name).

files.Title: OnixRuntime.Api.World.Scoreboards.ScoreboardObjective
files.Summary: Represents a scoreboard objective, providing access to its properties and scores.

files.Title: OnixRuntime.Api.World.Scoreboards.ScoreboardObjectiveRenderType
files.Summary: Specifies the render type for a scoreboard objective.

files.Title: OnixRuntime.Api.World.Scoreboards.ScoreboardObjectiveSortOrder
files.Summary: Specifies the sort order for a scoreboard objective.

files.Title: OnixRuntime.Api.World.Scoreboards.ScoreboardScoreOperation
files.Summary: Specifies the operation to perform on a scoreboard score.

files.Title: OnixRuntime.Api.World.VanillaBlockStateType
files.Summary: Represents the various block state types in the game but in an enum for convenience.

files.Title: OnixRuntime.Api.World.WorldBlocks.BlockUpdateType
files.Summary: Specifies the type of block update to perform.

files.Title: OnixRuntime.Api.World.WorldBlocks
files.Summary: Provides access to world blocks, including block retrieval, setting, biome, lighting, collisions, and raycasting. You only need to dispose of this when you create your own. Note that you should probably create it on the thread you plan on using it on.

files.Title: OnixRuntime.Api.World.WorldChunk.ChunkState
files.Summary: Specifies the state of a chunk.

files.Title: OnixRuntime.Api.World.WorldChunk.FoundBlock
files.Summary: Represents a block found in the chunk using FindBlock.

files.Title: OnixRuntime.Api.World.WorldChunk
files.Summary: Represents a chunk in the world, providing access to its properties, state, and block data.

files.Title: OnixRuntime.Api.World.WorldChunks
files.Summary: Represents a collection of world chunks, providing access to chunk positions, dimension, world, and chunk retrieval.

files.Title: OnixRuntime.Api.World.WorldChunksIterator
files.Summary: Enumerates the world chunks in a collection.

files.Title: OnixRuntime.Extensions.TimeSpanExtensions
files.Summary: Provides extension methods for converting between TimeSpan and game ticks.

files.Title: OnixRuntime.Plugin.IOnixPlugin
files.Summary: A basic onix plugin interface to interact with other plugins.

files.Title: OnixRuntime.Plugin.OnixPluginBase
files.Summary: Base class for Onix plugins, providing access to plugin manifest, asset paths, persistent data, and lifecycle events.

files.Title: OnixRuntime.Plugin.OnixPluginInitInfo
files.Summary: Contains initialization information for an Onix plugin, including manifest, asset paths, persistent data, cancellation, and bound DLLs.

files.Title: OnixRuntime.Plugin.OnixPluginInstaller.TaskProgressReport
files.Summary: Represents progress and status for a long-running plugin operation.

files.Title: OnixRuntime.Plugin.OnixPluginInstaller

files.Summary: Class responsible for saving and loading onix module data in plugins. This is for the default setting system, you can go the manual route of course.

files.Title: OnixRuntime.Plugin.PluginLoadMode
files.Summary: Specifies the various modes for loading plugins.

files.Title: OnixRuntime.Plugin.PluginManifest

files.Title: OnixRuntime.Plugin.RemotePluginManifest
files.Summary: A that includes the original remote source URL the manifest was retrieved from.

files.Title: OnixRuntime.Plugin.RuntimeManifest
files.Summary: Represents the runtime manifest, including runtime version information.

files.Title: OnixRuntime.Plugin.SupportedVersionRange
files.Summary: Represents a range of supported versions, either a single version or a range of versions.

files.Title: OnixRuntime.Runtime.OnixRuntimeConfig
